newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close higher with soybeans.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close higher with soybeans.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed higher, boosted by gains in soybeans and on a technical bounce, traders said.
The soy complex found support from reports that Sparks Companies pegged the 1996 U.S. soybean crop at a level below trade expectations.
Talk that China was seeking soybeans and soy products also underpinned the market.
But most traders said the markets were oversold for the near term and due for a recovery, yet long-term indicators remained bearish.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 13,000 contracts, up from 12,811 Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 22,000 contracts, up from 20,650 Tuesday.
Soyoil closed 0.16 to 0.24 cent per lb higher, with December up 0.21 at 23.03. Soymeal closed $4.50 per ton higher to $0.50 lower, with December up $4.50 at $224.90.
